author: Nerdstalgic
description:
At its peak, Rick and Morty felt unstoppable. Pickle Rick dominated the internet, McDonald's brought back Szechuan Sauce, and every new episode became a cultural event. The show wasn't just successful, it redefined what adult animation could be.

But somewhere along the way, that magic disappeared.

From the show's explosive rise to behind the scenes controversy, a major creative shift might be why Rick and Morty may never recapture what made it one of the animated TV shows of the 2010s.

title: The OTHER Major Problem With Rick And Morty
